semiconductor_relevance: High — Okuno Taiwan Co., Ltd. provides essential materials and surface treatment solutions critical for semiconductor fabrication processes.
summary: Okuno Taiwan Co., Ltd. specializes in providing advanced materials and surface treatment solutions for the semiconductor industry. Their product offerings include etchants, cleaning chemicals, solvents, strippers, and spin-on glass materials, which are crucial for semiconductor fabrication. The company supports customers from product design through to mass production, ensuring solutions meet specific industry requirements.
capabilities: Spin-on glass materials for dielectric layers

regional_presence.Taiwan: Okuno Taiwan Co., Ltd. operates in Taiwan, providing local support and solutions tailored to the semiconductor industry.
